implementation.shared_plan: TaskValueTypes builds all nominal physical layouts iteratively using planRecordPhysicalLayout, honoring managed-reference and descriptor field decisions

implementation.representations: Preserves numeric widths, Bool, String, callable pairs, TaskError, collection descriptors, completed result/error wrappers and pending task handles
implementation.validation: Shared field/error-family metadata and expansion/depth/work limits are enforced; missing/unavailable scalar/error nominal identities reject before lookup
implementation.separation: No source admission or continuation instruction changes; physical recursion support does not enable recursive task execution
implementation.test_locator: Private callable-aggregate probe accepts optional LLVM nonnull argument annotation while preserving its 40-byte environment and callable-entry name requirements

groups.failures: Both callable-aggregate suites stopped at a private IR locator that did not accept ptr nonnull @callee. Their preceding compiled source programs returned 42.

groups.reason: Updated only the optional-attribute locator; rerun includes the native ownership harness, source cases, worker pool probes and failure cleanup.
